description: List currently ACKNOWLEDGED (being worked on, not yet resolved) incidents for a team. Spike: GET /incidents/acknowledged (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

name: spike_list_acknowledged_incidents
title: List acknowledged incidents
